instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. Inside a dimly lit boxing ring with hanging punching bags, the woman in the black and orange sports top (R1) stands on the left, facing right. She holds a red focus mitt with her left hand while keeping her right gloved hand raised near her chin. The woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands on the right, back partially to the camera, landing a right punch with her black glove onto the red mitt. Cool overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
elements: R1 holds the focus mitt for R2 to punch
R2 lands the punch onto R1's mitt
R1 presents the mitt while keeping a gloved hand raised near her chin
R2 punches with a black glove while partly turned away from the camera
dimly lit boxing ring with hanging punching bags
